Shah Rukh Khan's 'King' Reportedly Sets Pre-Release Record with Rs 175 Crore Overseas Rights Deal

02 Nov 2026, 08:30 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysShah Rukh Khan’s upcoming film King has reportedly secured an overseas theatrical distribution deal valued at Rs 175 crore. According to media reports, Dubai-based Phars Films has acquired the international rights through a minimum guarantee (MG) agreement, marking a notable pre-release development for the project.

Pre-Release Milestone in International Markets

Shah Rukh Khan’s upcoming film *King* has reportedly secured an overseas theatrical distribution deal valued at Rs 175 crore. According to media reports, Dubai-based Phars Films has acquired the international rights through a minimum guarantee (MG) agreement, marking a notable pre-release development for the project.

Trade analysts note that this reported figure surpasses previous benchmarks for Indian films in terms of overseas minimum guarantees. Previously, international distribution for several of the actor's major releases, including *Pathaan* and *Jawan*, was associated with Yash Raj Films.

Understanding the Minimum Guarantee Agreement

  • An MG deal involves a distributor committing a fixed upfront amount to secure distribution rights.
  • The arrangement provides producers with guaranteed funds prior to the film's theatrical run.
  • The distributor assumes the commercial risk of recovering the investment through ticket sales and applicable revenue streams.

Box-Office Expectations and Break-Even Estimates

According to trade estimates cited in reports, overseas distributors typically retain roughly 50 percent of gross box-office collections. Based on this standard metric, *King* would reportedly need to generate approximately Rs 350 to Rs 375 crore in international gross collections to offset the reported Rs 175 crore investment.

To contextualize these projections:

  • Shah Rukh Khan's 2023 releases, *Pathaan* and *Jawan*, each reportedly grossed around Rs 400 crore in overseas markets.
  • The estimated break-even benchmark depends on theatrical performance, distribution costs, and final agreement terms rather than official producer announcements.

Production Details and Cast

Directed by Siddharth Anand and produced by Red Chillies Entertainment in association with Marflix Pictures, *King* features an ensemble cast. Alongside Shah Rukh Khan, the film stars Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Anil Kapoor, and several others. The project marks the first on-screen collaboration between Shah Rukh Khan and his daughter Suhana Khan.

The film is currently scheduled for a theatrical release on December 24, 2026. Audiences and industry observers can verify final release schedules and official updates through announcements directly from the production houses.
